item.title: AVANTASIA’s 'Here Be Dragons' Features KAMELOT’s Tommy Karevik on New Single The Witch
item.description: Well, folks, let me tell ya’ll, Tobias Sammet is back with another Avantasia album, and this time he’s gone full medieval cartographer on us. The tenth studio album, Here Be Dragons, is set to release on February 28, 2025, via Napalm Records, and based on everything we know, it’s shaping up to be either a symphonic masterpiece or the musical equivalent of a Renaissance Fair gone horribly wrong.
